versions.content: On certain systems the CC might share resources with other components (e.g., the MCU), and might depend on their configurations. If those resources are within the scope of the other modules (e.g., PLL configuration, memory mapping), then the Fr module doesn’t configure those components but requires that their initialization precede the Fr module’s initialization.
